segments.EPH.1.3-4: Paul praises God who blessed and chose believers in Christ
segments.EPH.1.5-6: God chose believers to be his children through Jesus
segments.EPH.1.7-8: In Christ believers are forgiven through his blood
segments.EPH.1.9-10: God made known his plan to unite all things in Christ
segments.EPH.1.11-12: God chose believers as his own people for his praise
segments.EPH.1.13-14: Believers who heard and believed receive the Holy Spirit
segments.EPH.1.15-16: Paul thanks God for the Ephesians’ faith and love
segments.EPH.1.17-18: Paul prays for believers to have wisdom to know God
segments.EPH.1.19-21: God’s great power raised Christ and set him over all
segments.EPH.1.22-23: God made Christ head over everything for the church
segments.EPH.2.1-3: Before Christ, believers were dead in sin
segments.EPH.2.4-7: God in his mercy made believers alive with Christ
segments.EPH.2.8-10: God saves believers by grace through faith, not by works
segments.EPH.2.11-12: Gentile believers were once far from Christ and Israel
segments.EPH.2.13-16: Christ makes Jews and Gentiles one through the cross
segments.EPH.2.17-18: Christ brings peace so all can come to the Father
segments.EPH.3.1-2: Paul is a prisoner who serves the Gentiles by God’s grace
segments.EPH.3.3-5: God showed Paul the mystery of Christ by revelation
segments.EPH.3.6-7: Gentiles are fellow heirs in Christ through the gospel
segments.EPH.3.8-9: Paul was given grace to preach Christ to the Gentiles
segments.EPH.3.10-11: God shows his wisdom to rulers through the church
segments.EPH.3.12-13: In Christ believers can come to God with confidence
segments.EPH.3.14-16: Paul prays that God will strengthen believers with power
segments.EPH.3.17-19: Paul prays that believers will know Christ’s great love
segments.EPH.3.20-21: Paul gives glory to God who can do more than we ask
segments.EPH.4.1-3: Paul urges believers to live humbly and keep unity
segments.EPH.4.4-6: Believers share one body, one Lord, and one God
segments.EPH.4.7-8: Christ gives grace to each believer as a gift
segments.EPH.4.9-10: Christ went down and then rose above all the heavens
segments.EPH.4.11-13: Christ gave leaders to prepare believers for service
segments.EPH.4.14-16: Believers grow up in Christ and build up the body in love
segments.EPH.4.17-19: Paul tells believers not to live like the Gentiles
segments.EPH.4.20-22: Believers were taught to put off the old self
segments.EPH.4.23-24: Believers are to be renewed and put on the new self
segments.EPH.4.25-27: Believers must speak truth and not stay angry
segments.EPH.4.28-30: Believers must work, share, and speak helpful words
segments.EPH.4.31-32: Believers must get rid of anger and forgive each other
segments.EPH.5.1-2: Believers should imitate God and walk in love like Christ
segments.EPH.5.3-4: Believers must avoid sexual sin, greed, and foolish talk
segments.EPH.5.5-7: Immoral and greedy people have no share in God’s kingdom
segments.EPH.5.8-12: Believers are now light and must avoid deeds of darkness
segments.EPH.5.15-17: Believers should live wisely and know the Lord’s will
segments.EPH.5.18-20: Believers are to be filled with the Spirit and give thanks
segments.EPH.5.21-21: Believers submit to one another out of respect for Christ
segments.EPH.5.22-24: Wives should submit to husbands as to the Lord
segments.EPH.5.25-27: Husbands must love wives as Christ loved the church
segments.EPH.5.28-30: A husband who loves his wife loves himself
segments.EPH.5.31-33: Husbands must love wives, and wives must respect husbands
segments.EPH.6.1-3: Children must obey and honor father and mother
segments.EPH.6.4-4: Fathers must raise children with the Lord’s teaching
segments.EPH.6.5-8: Slaves must obey masters sincerely, as serving Christ
segments.EPH.6.9-9: Masters must treat slaves well and stop threatening
segments.EPH.6.10-11: Paul urges believers to be strong and wear God’s armor
segments.EPH.6.12-13: Believers fight evil spiritual forces, not people
segments.EPH.6.14-16: Believers stand firm with truth, righteousness, and faith
segments.EPH.6.17-18: Believers take salvation and God’s word, and pray always
segments.EPH.6.19-20: Paul asks believers to pray that he will speak boldly
segments.EPH.6.21-22: Paul sends Tychicus to inform and encourage the church
segments.EPH.6.23-24: Paul ends with peace, love, and grace for believers
